from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyIntangibleAssets(BaseModel):
    """Intangible Assets information from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/securities code if available")
    intangible_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported Intangible Assets value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., 'Yuan'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the figure is as of")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt containing the intangible assets figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_intangible_assets: list[CompanyIntangibleAssets]
